patch.value: Raises the pm-cli peerDependency to >=2026.7.27 and the devDependency to ^2026.7.27, refreshes the lockfile, and bumps all THREE version sites: package.json, manifest.json and the module's own self-reported version constant. Bumping only package.json leaves an installed extension reporting a stale version to the host and to pm extension --manage, which a reviewer caught on the sibling pm-starter change. An activation proof is mandatory rather than optional for this bump because 2026.7.27 hardened host-owned global flags: a collision aborts command registration AT the offending command, dropping it and every later sibling, while --help still exits 0 with a misleading Commander arity error (upstream pm-cli#772). Verified on the real CLI in a throwaway workspace: install ok with no warnings, pm jira --help exits 0, host commands stay intact (pm list --json still valid), and the flag-collision audit finds no host-owned global declared.

patch.value: peerDependencies >=2026.7.27 and devDependencies ^2026.7.27 with a refreshed lockfile; package.json, manifest.json and the module version constant all read 2026.7.27; node_modules resolves 2026.7.27; pm jira --help exits 0 on the real CLI with the built extension installed; flag-collision audit clean; host pm list --json still valid; 78 tests pass.
Shipped with the activation proof the hardened 2026.7.27 host requires.
